requirements.quote: Riders must be able to request a ride from their current location.
The app shall show the estimated arrival time of the driver.
Drivers must be able to accept or decline a ride request.
Payment is made in cash only.
Riders can pay by card or wallet inside the app.
The app should handle a large number of users.
The app depends on a third party maps service for routing.
Fares are calculated based on distance and time.
What happens when no driver is available nearby?
